args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and passwordResetEmail (along with rollupText and scheduledExportEmail) builds its links from this value. In production, PUBLIC_URL appears to be unset or not reaching the process, so reset links, rollup links, and export links all point at localhost instead of the deployed URL.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL (or an equivalent configured production URL, e.g. from the config module already imported here) is always set correctly in the deployment environment, and ideally fail fast or log a warning at startup if it is missing/falls back to localhost outside of local development, so this class of bug is caught before emails go out.
